items.text: Hang Seng fell 4.3% over the past week, a big move for it. Usually a drag on Integrated Steel and Aluminium & Extrusions.
The NIFTY 500 rose 0.3% on 17 Nov. Financial Services was the strongest sector (+0.6%) and Information Technology the weakest (−0.8%).

FIIs bought a net ₹4,195 Cr and DIIs bought a net ₹197 Cr of Indian shares on 17 Nov. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 54 niches; Rigid, Glass & Industrial Packaging, Complex / Niche API and Flexible Packaging & Films and others joined today. Heavy delivery buying this week in Large PSU Banks, Luggage & Bags and Travel Services & Railways Catering.
